research.notes: Legal name per ProPublica is 'Kaboom Inc'; 'KABOOM!' used as shown on the organization's own site. No general email found. OUSD link confirmed via Eat.Learn.Play. Foundation press release (https://www.eatlearnplay.org/news/global-family-elementary), not cited as a source.

profile.summary: KABOOM! is a national nonprofit that works to end playspace inequity. It works with communities to design and build playspaces with kids, with a focus on communities of color that have less access to places to play.

Play. press release names KABOOM! and OUSD together on the Global Family Elementary playground, matching the Playspace agreements.
